answer: Reputation is a scarce, unforgeable resource earned by consistently passing originality checks, and the economy spends it to filter out Sybil clusters before they can compound into a majority. It survives because reputation is spent fast and earned slowly, so any alias that ever cheats loses value that is expensive to replace. In practice this means a farm must spend real resources on every single alias, and that per-identity cost is what keeps the network honest at scale. Consider a jade as the anchor of the cost.
